Iris (billing): Heads up — seeing a batch of duplicate credit memos in NetSuite from last night's refund sync. ~53 accounts.
Jonas (eng): Only in NetSuite?
Iris (billing): Yep. Stripe shows one refund id per event, NS has two CMs for many. Example: rf_X8f -> CM-3390 and CM-3391.
Leah (platform): We pushed a small proxy change to canonicalize some vendor headers at 01:05 UTC. Might be related.
infra-bot: deploy complete: release/2026-08-01-01:02 by @Leah
Jonas (eng): If the proxy altered the signature header name/value, our verifier could have failed and put events into replay. Our replay path currently computes idempotency from the raw request (including headers). Header mutation would change the idempotency key.
Iris (billing): logs show the sequence:
```
WARN billing:webhooks - signature missing for evt_X8f
INFO billing:replay - enqueued evt_X8f attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-3390 for refund rf_X8f
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit_memo CM-3391 for refund rf_X8f (replayed)
```
Leah (platform): Confirmed: proxy rule lowercased header names for compatibility and also trimmed some whitespace. That affected a subset of webhook traffic at 01:05-01:12.
Jonas (eng): Root cause = proxy header mutation + idempotency keyed on non-stable fields. Quick fixes: 1) make signature lookup case-insensitive and tolerant to whitespace, 2) change idempotency to stable keys (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) revert header canonicalization for /webhooks.
Iris (billing): For remediation: can we auto-void the later credit memo when external_ref (refund id) and amount match and creation delta < 12 minutes? ~53 affected. Need finance approval to run automated voids and attach an audit note.
finance-approvals: Approve automated void for up to 100 accounts pending dry-run results.
Leah (platform): Rolling back proxy rule for webhook paths now. Will monitor and post status.
infra-bot: proxy rollback applied at 1767008400
Jonas (eng): Opening PR for verifier and idempotency changes with unit+integration tests. Will require deploy after review.
Iris (billing): We will run a dry-run backfill to list candidate duplicates, then run the void job after confirmation. Scheduling dry-run for 1767010200.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-11045 created: "Proxy header mutation -> webhook replay created duplicate NetSuite credit memos" assigned to Jonas, priority P1
Leah (platform): Hotfix deployed to preserve signature headers at 1767008600. Monitoring logs show signature header intact for subsequent webhooks.
Jonas (eng): PR merged and deployed at 1767009800. Idempotency now computed from event_id + refund_id only. Added regression test for header-casing/whitespace.
Iris (billing): Dry-run completed: 53 matches. Backfill scheduled 1767010800 (will void later CM where match and add audit note "auto-void dup from webhook replay"). Posting results to #finance-updates after run.
Iris (billing): Backfill finished: voided 53 duplicate credit memos, created audit notes, no customer-facing refunds issued (NetSuite-only). Closing loop. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
